name: ICE Melts On The Riviera
source:
The Riviera Resort lobby smells like citrus polish and money. Mid-afternoon light turns marble into pale fire.

In Ice Melts on the Riviera, you arrive as Jack Mercer, an affluent guest with a perfect cover and an imperfect conscience. The resort is built for indulgence—but you’re here to observe, gain access, and uncover truths that shouldn’t be yours.

Between polished hallways and moonlit garden paths, the assignment starts to blur into something sharper: attraction, guilt, and the risk of wanting something real.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4283380/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
里维埃拉度假村的大堂闻起来有柑橘味和金钱的味道。午后的阳光将大理石变成苍白的火焰。

在《里维埃拉的冰雪融化》中，你扮演杰克·默瑟，一位富有的客人，有着完美的掩护和不完美的良心。该度假村是为放纵而建的，但你来这里是为了观察、进入并发现不属于你的真相。

在光洁的走廊和月光下的花园小径之间，任务开始变得更加清晰：吸引力、内疚和想要真实的东西的风险。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4283380/]Steam[/url]]
